epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
Structural: (1) No Slot entity: a 'free' List IS the Slot (id L-reg-date-session, statusKey free). Recommend keeping this model and changing vocabulary (Slot vs List) in copy rather than adding a table. (2) Draft List needs a new collection (own id prefix, hospital, surgeon, day, session, createdAt, closed reason), PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13) and seed data. Naming collision is worse than the reviewer noted: every generated empty Slot carries ListState 'DRAFT' and the admin ListDrawer header prints it (ListDrawer.tsx:50), so an empty slot reads 'DRAFT'. UI wording for the lifecycle state needs renaming or Draft Lists need distinct wording ('Being prepared'). If Draft Lists can hold Bookings (OQ-44 recommendation) Cards need a parent that is not an anaesthetist's List. (3) List.statusKey conflates availability (free/unavailable/holiday) with booking class (private/public/preop). OQ-17 and OQ-27 decide the vocabulary; plan US-01.2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 5.3 together after that ruling or with an explicit interim assumption. statusKeyParity test and StatusLegend depend on the six keys.
Verification changes: EP-01, FT-01.2, FT-01.3, US-01.3.1 moved to Contradicts (assigned Lists with no surgeon/hospital are deliberately built and seeded; displayed status depends on bookings); US-01.3.2 moved Matches to Partial (new/edited Permanent List does not reach the existing canvas, weekend templates silently ignored, no delete); US-01.5.4 moved to Contradicts (un-blocking a booked session writes a new conflict, and no path clears a conflict). New small defects: pressing Free on an already-booked own session flags a bogus availability conflict; Anaesthetist.active has no canvas effect; reassign default vacated status is Unavailable (catalogue: available).
Dependencies: blacklist master (US-13.6.3, EP-13) blocks US-01.3.5, 01.4.5 and part of 01.6.3. Matching screen (US-02.1.2) is the second Draft List entry point. Update-email button after reassignment (OQ-46, US-02.3.3) hooks onto reassignList. One-day dashboard (US-13.1.1) must show Draft Lists. Audit (US-13.5.2) already covers reassignList/setAvailability.
Demo controls: harness bar has no screen-contextual slot (confirmed in shell map). 'Simulate incoming request' (Draft Lists) and 'Simulate sickness' (Admin day view) need a shared contextual-trigger registry in src/shared modelled on demoClockShortcuts, so the PWA import closure stays pure. Most other items demo through existing UI or the clock.
Demo script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S2 Beat 1 'two half-day Lists' wording becomes Slots; S2 Beat 2 phone-advice booking admits anaesthetist views still show Free (fixed by US-01.2.3/01.3.3, caveat and Expected line change); the seeded Fitzgerald 'Surgeon TBC' List (Tue 21 PM) must change or become a Draft List under US-01.3.1; S2 Beat 3 vacated-slot Unavailable vs catalogue default Available. New beats likely: Draft List create/assign with waiting flag, blacklist warning, conflict dashboard, swap request with office confirm.
Scale note: 14 anaesthetists seeded; 85 covered only by a scale test.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: Structural: (1) Core gap is a new Admin matching screen plus a staged inbound-row store slice (e.g. integrations.inboundRows). FT-02.1, US-02.1.1 to 02.1.5, 02.5.1 and 02.5.6 depend on it. Re-route processMessage so HL7/FHIR messages and download rows are staged (with change type new/modify/reschedule/cancel) and applied only on admin decision, reusing the existing guarded write paths and MSH-10 dedupe. The unmatched queue is the same screen. Because the shared cancel/reschedule/modify story images are captured from the current simulator (message received then applied), the staging change also alters S12 to S15 demo beats. (2) Draft List (unassigned, no Slot; US-01.6.1, DM-05/06) is a prerequisite for the 'create Draft List' action in US-02.1.2; Lists currently always have an anaesthetist. (3) Card to Booking rename (DM-01) touches all copy here; do it first. (4) Intake channel is not recorded: AuditSource has no pdf/download/admin-entry values, PDF ingest and phone advice are both 'office'. Add an intake-channel field (or audit sub-source) to Booking to satisfy EP-02 'source recorded' and FT-02.5. (5) US-02.3.2 explicit save is the enabler for US-02.3.3 (change set to email) and US-02.5.6 (conflicts caught at save); CardDetailBody is shared with anaesthetists, so buffering must be admin-only or a separate admin edit mode. BrowserRouter (not a data router) means the unsaved-changes guard needs beforeunload plus an in-app guard, not useBlocker. (6) Domain: contact emails on Hospital and Surgeons' room (US-13.4.1, US-13.6.1) for US-02.3.3; rowVersion fields on Card/Procedure for US-02.5.6; persisted contract snapshot for US-02.5.5. Bump PERSIST_VERSION (13) when seed shape changes. (7) Shell: no screen-contextual demo control exists (AppShell harness bar is static, DemoClockMenu and DemoResetButton only); proposed triggers (Sync now / Simulate scheduled pull / Fail next sync on the matching screen; 'Hospital changes this booking now' on admin booking detail; sample download loader; 'Upload PDF' simulated on Surgeon PDFs) need a small screen-scoped DemoContextMenu slot using route matchPath, with logic kept in src/shared or src/store for pwaPurity. (8) Verifier changes vs reviewer: US-02.2.1 Matches to Partial (no upload action, S), US-02.5.2 Matches to Partial (silent time-only fallthrough when no target List, S), US-02.5.1 size L to M, EP-02 gains the intake-channel point. Still Matches: US-02.4.1, US-02.4.3 (low confidence, billingReference not copied), US-02.5.3, US-02.5.4. Demo script beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 around lines 94-110 (S12 New booking replay currently lands Sarah Mitchell automatically; would need a matching-screen accept step); S2 Beat 2 phone advice (~line 171, 179); S4 Beat 4 integration dead-letter (~324-331); S5 MSG-STG-1002 (~381); line 410 'last-write-wins' must change if US-02.5.6 is built; Control Panel scenario messages and 'Ingest PDF row' card; PWA panel unaffected (mobile only).

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: Structural: (1) Catalogue says Booking; prototype says Card everywhere (CardId, cardActions, audit entityType, copy). DM-01 rename pass touches all items; do wording criteria (e.g. 'NHI missing') alongside it. (2) Primary/additional cluster (FT-03.2, US-03.2.1, US-03.2.2, plus US-02.4.3 copy): replace isAdditional with isPrimary + exactly-one invariant, Booking-level modifier split above 4 units (feeFor prices one Procedure in isolation), Contract multiProcedureRule, seed/test/worked-example changes, and fix copyCard, which today creates a new Card whose only Procedure is flagged additional (no primary, time units only). Verifier upgraded FT-03.2 Matches to Contradicts for this. Plan these together in one phase. OQ-53 (bundle procedures) and OQ-06 (Procedure master, pick by operation) are open: do not build. (3) Contract cluster (FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-03.1.2, US-03.2.3, FT-03.5/US-03.5.1, FT-03.6/US-03.6.1) depends on EP-04: Contract.allowsAnaesthetistAdjustment, requiredBookingInputs, scope filtering (US-04.3.2), default Contract selected at Booking creation (createCard/integration/manual/photo set none; selectContract only runs at invoice build), plus an office-review flag for anaesthetist Contract changes (US-07.2.2; reviewFlags has none). Anaesthetist Edit sheet still edits billing route/insurer directly (old route model, DM-06). (4) Split priceOverride into anaesthetistAdjustment (percent or fixed, Contract-gated, after BTM complete) and officeOverride. (5) Attachments need List.attachments and a file path (US-03.1.3). (6) Small fixes: web own-availability control (US-03.1.4), 'NHI missing' wording and blank mobile row (US-03.1.5). (7) Any seed shape change needs PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). Demo script impact: S1 Beat 3 (Sarah Mitchell via MSG-STG-1001 createCard, no Contract) breaks if Contract becomes a completion requirement unless creation assigns the hospital default Contract; multi-procedure changes alter seeded multi-procedure cards, the bariatric Type 3 ordinal case and S3 worked-example numbers. Only demo button needed: inbound-feed 'swap primary' (US-03.2.2); everything else is user-operable. Verifier changes vs reviewer: FT-03.2 Matches to Contradicts; FT-03.6 Grouping to Partial (states the validation rule itself, overlaps US-03.6.1, do not double count effort). All other verdicts upheld; 5 Matches (US-03.1.1, 03.3.3, 03.3.4, 03.5.2, 03.6.2) re-opened against code and held."

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: Structural: catalogue Contract is a new object (category, pricingBasis, scope filters, versions, fee-schedule lines with GST/time band/add-on/quantity/effective-from, multiProcedureRule, allowsAnaesthetistAdjustment, requiredBookingInputs, invoiceLayout/deliveryMethod/gstTreatment, baseUnitOverrides, reviewDate). Prototype Contract is the old RFP Type 1/2/3 + holder + org/individual scope + dates (domain/types.ts:216). One domain rework unlocks ~10 items: suggest ONE phase for Contract model + admin editor + seed + PERSIST_VERSION bump (13 today), then a second for selection/default/mandatory gate/lock/versioning, and a third for removing billing route as a mandatory concept (biggest cross-cutting contradiction: validateCardForBilling, ROUTE_LABELS, ManualCardForm, EditBillingSetupSheet, counterpartyForProcedure, review columns, HL7/photo createCard). Verification corrections: US-04.2.5 Partial to Contradicts (default rule omits modifier split above four; shared fix with US-05.3.1); US-04.3.1 size S to M; EP-04 size L to XL. All other verdicts upheld after re-reading code. Every Confirmed Matches item (US-04.3.4) and both Matches features/stories re-checked; FT-04.4/US-04.4.1 are true matches on behaviour, with category naming deferred to US-04.1.1 and a minor insurer-default effective-date inconsistency. Dependencies: EP-05 (Procedure master US-05.1.6 / OQ-06 base units, US-05.2.5/05.2.6 fee schedule + rate x time, US-05.3.1 multi-procedure/modifier split, US-05.4.1/05.4.2 adjustment and office override), EP-11 (billable party US-11.2.2, direct insurer portal US-11.4.1), EP-08 (invoice reproduction US-08.4.4, layout US-08.4.1), EP-06 (prepayment overlay), EP-03 (mark complete US-03.6.1). Open questions: OQ-48 (deciding date; prototype prices on List date = recommendation), OQ-06, OQ-18, OQ-53 unresolved; graded on text as written. Demo triggers: nothing here is scheduler-driven; time-effective prices (US-04.2.10) reuse the demo clock (note pricing keys off List date, so show two Lists either side of the effective date); default contract on new Cards reuses MSG-STG-1001 injection; versioning is an admin edit-sheet feature. Demo-guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S5 Beat 4 (contract end-dating on Health NZ; reword for versioned Contracts / dated price lines / version-locked invoice), S4 Beat 3 and Control Panel 'Trigger billing failure' (editContract effectiveTo 2026-07-15 on CONTRACT.cosAcc; with mandatory snapshotted Contracts and US-04.3.7 flag instead of silent fallback this failure path needs redesign), S3 (Contract column on Review), S1 (HL7 Card should show default Contract), S2 (billing setup screens). Gotchas: UI copy bakes in 'Type 1/2/3' names (seeded contract names, picker labels, master-data header); DemoControlPanel hardcodes CONTRACT.cosAcc; domain/seed/cards.ts assigns governingContractId per card; 8th-review Decisions-log rulings (Type 3 no-match falls back to BTM; expired hospital/insurer contract falls back to default) may conflict with US-04.3.7 and mandatory-contract rules, check before changing. Story US-04.4.1 has a short body; graded with FT-04.4 text and screenshots.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: STRUCTURAL. (1) Biggest change is US-05.3.1 / FT-05.3: fee maths is per-Procedure (feeFor, procedureFee, cardFee, invoiceBuild each price one Procedure at a time), so the modifier split needs a Booking-level allocation step (pool modifiers, then 3/2/2 with remainder to the primary) and a decision on where modifiers are captured (probably on the primary, with ASA seeding it). Clean the additional procedure's own asaClass in the Holt split seed. Superseded 'time units only' copy sits in fee.ts line text (lands on invoice line descriptions), BtmCaptureBlock, UnitsCard captions, CardDetailBody 'Time units only' note, the Type 3 additional-procedure fallback comment/logic (fee.ts:206-214), and fee.test.ts:71,151. Add a guard in editProcedure so base units cannot be set on an additional Procedure. (2) Masters are all seed-only and view-only: new Procedure master (US-05.1.6) plus Contract base-unit override, AA-sourced RVG codes (US-05.1.1), many-to-many RVG groups (US-05.1.3) and 10 missing modifier codes (US-05.1.5; drop or justify PO1/PO2). Admin CRUD plus PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13) needed. (3) Split anaesthetist adjustment from office override into two fields applied in order (BTM, contract price, anaesthetist adjustment, office override), with a Contract flag allowsAnaesthetistAdjustment and percent / fixed-final-price types for the anaesthetist (US-05.4.1, FT-05.4); today one Procedure.priceOverride is shared and the anaesthetist gets $ and fixed. (4) Contract fields to add: baseUnitOverrides, multiProcedureRule (RVG default / second-code percent / add-on fee / not billable), allowsAnaesthetistAdjustment, fixed-schedule line detail (holder code, time band, add-on, quantity, ex/inc GST). Effort is best costed once: US-05.3.1 (L), US-05.1.6 (L), US-05.4.1 (L); FT-05.3 and FT-05.4 are the same work and should not be planned twice. DEPENDENCIES: EP-04 (US-04.2.2 pricing basis and base overrides, US-04.2.4 schedule lines, US-04.2.5 multi-procedure rule, US-04.3.5 contract snapshot at AUTHORISED; prototype resolves governingContractId live); EP-03 (US-03.3.1 pick by operation name vs RVG code per OQ-06, itemised modifiers); EP-06 (prepaid by RVG group needs US-05.1.3 groups; prepayment estimate and OQ-50 duration rule); US-08.6.4 additional invoices for OQ-53 combined procedures (not modelled; no bundle concept in src). RULINGS TO RESPECT: 2026-09-28 user decision hides the fee/calculation from the anaesthetist Card. Catalogue screenshots for US-05.2.1, 05.3.5 and 05.4.1 were taken 24-25 Sep, before it, and show anaesthetist-facing totals; treated as stale, needs a product-owner call before rebuilding those views (US-05.4.1's 'total shows the fee before it' cannot be shown to the anaesthetist otherwise). OPEN QUESTIONS AFFECTING GRADES: OQ-06 (Procedure master / picker), OQ-15 (remainder split), OQ-18 (holder codes), OQ-50 (rule after 2h; code already matches stated rule), OQ-53 (bundles), OQ-12 (ACC pre-op codes). DEMO SCRIPT IMPACT (docs/demo-guide): S3 Beat 1 uses AA-2026-0002 Brian Holt Forte Health $396.18 as the 'split-billing Card' (additional procedure, AS2 on both); under the new rule the amount depends on how ASA is pooled, so recheck it, and the 'split billing / time units only' wording in the demo guide, cheat sheet and master HTML must change. S1 Beat 3 (Start now, +1 hour, Finish now) is unaffected. S4/S5 override narration is touched lightly by the adjustment/override split. Matching items (US-05.1.4, 05.2.1, 05.2.2, 05.2.3, 05.2.6, 05.2.7, 05.4.2, 05.5.1, 05.3.5 pending US-05.3.1, FT-05.2, FT-05.5) need no work beyond wording tweaks. VERIFICATION RESULT: all 24 verdicts upheld; only content corrections were dropping non-requirement points (OQ-53 bundles from FT-05.3, base-unit caveat from FT-05.2, GST configurability from US-05.2.7, US-04.2.4 items from US-05.2.5) and adding the Type 3 additional fallback, the editProcedure guard, and the seed ASA double-count risk.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations:
Structural: the prototype models prepayment as a per-Procedure category (billableParty route + selfFundedPrepayment + prepaymentDetail full/split). The catalogue makes it a Booking property driven by the anaesthetist's prepaid RVG set, so the trigger moves and the hand-picked 'Pre-payment' option in the payment category pickers (EditProcedureSheet, EditBillingSetupSheet, ManualCardForm) goes. Collides with EP-04/EP-05 model changes (billing route/category removal, Contract required, RVG groups US-05.1.3). Parent sizes (EP-06, FT-*) are rollups, not additive.

Verified in code: no writer of prepaymentDetail outside the seed, so a UI-chosen 'Pre-payment' category never gets full/split and completion validation fails with no control to answer it. Raise treats missing detail as 'full' and prices via feeFor on captured/selected units with the contract stripped, so a pre-procedure full estimate has no time units (under-estimates or refuses with a misleading 'no self funded pre-payment procedure' message). Only the seeded Riley (split $800) and Nair (full, paid) cards demo the flow.

Completion hard-gate with audited override (lifecycle.ts:93-125, PrepaymentOverrideSheet) is a settled ruling. Catalogue text is silent but its screenshot captions ('gate cleared', 'mobile-card-gate') show it is tolerated; keep as a demo device unless AA rules otherwise. Stale copy to fix: banner and invoice note say 'RFP open question' / 'discovery point for AA'.

Dependencies: US-05.1.3 (RVG groups), US-05.2.2/OQ-50 (time rule), US-12.1.1 (unit value, exists), US-02.2.1/US-13.6.1 (estimated duration), US-08.6.2/US-08.2.2 (credit and rebill; a credit-note model is shared by US-06.4.2 and US-06.5.2), US-10.2.3/US-10.2.1 (receipts, payment run, trust timing), US-02.5.3 (cancel). OQ-38/40/42/50/03 all open, so Proposed items may shift.

Demo script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S4 Beat 1 (Souter Fri 24 Jul AM, Annette Riley: complete blocked -> Override gate -> complete) changes if the trigger moves to the profile; seeded Riley (split) and Nair (full, paid INV0001/BC0001) need reshaping and a PERSIST_VERSION bump. S1 to S3 unaffected unless the category picker is removed from booking setup. Proposed demo triggers: clock jump / reminder on Admin Day for date-approach alert, overpaid-prepayment scenario on Admin Review, trust-account refund payout in Demo Xero, rebook-with-replacement after refund.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: EP-07 is mostly built; gaps are small and cluster in four places. (1) US-07.2.2 (Confirmed) is the largest: needs an under-18 billable-party flag with warn/block (OQ-54 recommends flag at setup and review, block authorise; plan together with US-11.2.4, Patient.dobISO and ageYears already exist), explicit per-Procedure Contract approval, insurer/address/invoice-email visibility in review, and a Review-row link to the Card and its OfficeBillingSetup. (2) US-07.3.1 needs Contract versioning/snapshot onto Procedures at AUTHORISED; there is no Contract version concept (only effectiveFrom/To, in-place edits), so plan once with US-04.3.5 and the EP-08 snapshot work, not twice. (3) US-07.2.1 needs a web 'completed, unbilled' marker on the Lists table/WeekStrip and past unbilled Lists visible by default (ListsScreen defaults From to today). (4) US-07.4.1 matches today; if OQ-31 resolves to 'unbilled to billed and processed, not vanish' it becomes an S mobile/web change (billed marker or Billed filter) and possibly a deferred-invoice-generation demo toggle since the run is synchronous inside authoriseList. Terminology: catalogue says Booking, prototype UI says Card (submit sheet, review tiles, list rows); one cross-epic rename decision. Demo script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S2 Beat 4 (authorise Kate Morrison's Mon 20 Jul List) and S3 Beat 1 (authorise Melanie Forte AM/St George's PM) must stay non-blocking, so any child-billable-party seed must go on a separate List or scenario; the DemoControlPanel contract-snapshot compliance tour (DemoControlPanel.tsx:443) relies on invoice-level snapshot; the PWA office simulation (pwa/officeSimulation.ts) also drives authorise and must follow any authorise gating. Guard console (DemoData.tsx:245) already serves the 'edit refused' screenshots for US-07.2.1 and US-07.3.2. Feature/epic Grouping calls are safe: their bodies only restate children.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: Structural: (1) Biggest change is US-08.1.1. Removing engine-side route/contract resolution means billingRoute and the hospital/insurer default-contract fallback in invoiceBuild.ts:114-180 go, and a per-Procedure locked Contract snapshot is taken at booking/authorise. This is EP-04 work (US-04.3.5), cascading into validateCardForBilling, OfficeBillingSetup, seed cards and contracts. Bump PERSIST_VERSION (13). (2) No 'internal ledger' as such: BillingCase + invoices + receipts play that role, the receivable/payable pair only exists after the Xero handoff, and the admin payables-due panel and payables run read Xero-sim ACCPAY (payablesDue reads state.xero.accPays). Code, comments and Xero-sim copy still say 'billing mirror'. Fix terminology, consider explicit ledger receivable/payable records created with the invoice (also serves US-13.2.1, 08.3.4, 08.3.5 admin position). (3) Credit-note and additional-invoice entities are new domain types (linked to Procedure and original invoice, own number/pair/Xero pair/payable); Xero sim needs credit/void plus reversed ACCPAY (XeroAccRec 'voided' exists, unused). The post-op addendum Card (cardActions.ts:270) should be replaced by the admin additional-invoice flow (US-08.6.1, 6.3 both graded Contradicts against it); 08.6.1 and 08.6.3 are one build. (4) Missing fields: Anaesthetist.gstNumber and an invoice email on Booking (US-08.4.5, 08.4.2). (5) Product-owner rule: shell has no slot for screen-contextual demo buttons; AppShell.tsx:103-131 is the extension point (matchPath on routes); a shared trigger registry modelled on demoClockShortcuts.ts in src/shared (pwaPurity forbids shell/demo imports). Note most 08.6.x 'buttons' are product admin actions, not demo triggers; genuine demo-only candidates are 'Regenerate from locked data' (US-08.4.4) and an optional parallel-run variance panel (EP-08). Automatic engine sends (US-08.4.2) should show on the existing authorise action. (6) Verification changes: FT-08.6 -> Contradicts, US-08.3.2 -> Partial (admin payables from Xero sim), US-08.3.5 -> Partial (no admin/single-place view), US-08.6.3 -> Contradicts (addendum workaround). Minor: a fully prepaid Card that nets to $0 has no BillingCase and reads 'Pending' in the monitor (US-08.5.1 edge). Catalogue tension: FT-08.1 says no engine action before AUTHORISED while US-06.3.1 has the engine raising a prepayment invoice at booking setup. Dependencies: EP-04 (contract per Procedure/lock, US-04.3.5, US-04.2.8), EP-06 (prepayment, negative balance OQ-03), EP-05 (combined procedures OQ-53), EP-09/10 (Xero direction, payment matching, payables offset after credit OQ-42), EP-11 (billable party, invoice email), EP-13 (ledger balance US-13.2.1, monitoring, audit US-13.5.2). Demo script impacts (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S3 Beat 1 (authorise, invoice counts, 'resolves the explicit payer' wording, Email invoice step) if route/fallback/email change; S3 optional funder-reallocation aside if split moves to Contract cover; S4 Beat 2 post-op addendum (lines 303-310) replaced by the admin additional-invoice flow; S4 billing-failure beat (~line 320) breaks under a locked contract (COS ACC dating-out no longer fails at run time) so a new failure trigger is needed and Resolve & retry must stop editing contracts; S5 contract effective-dating beat (391-406) stays valid and is strengthened by versioning. A credit-and-rebill beat would fit S4 or S3. Open questions OQ-23/29/05/42/45/51/53 mean fixes for US-08.2.3, 08.4.5, 08.6.2 to 08.6.4 should follow recommended readings and be flagged provisional. Epic and feature sizes (EP-08, FT-08.3, FT-08.4, FT-08.6) are rollups of the child stories, do not add them.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations:
Verified all 17 EP-09 items against code. Changes from the first grading: FT-09.3 Grouping to Matches (states its own one-contact-per-patient rule, satisfied); US-09.2.1 Matches to Contradicts (authorised amount is 95% of received, against US-10.2.1 'exactly the amount received'); US-09.2.4 Matches to Partial (engine never detects a Xero-side ACCPAY payment, it performs the disbursement itself); US-09.4.1 Partial to Matches (low confidence; the catalogue's screenshot describes the existing screen). Others upheld.

Cross-epic root cause: the invented 5% AA service fee (agencyFee.ts, xeroHandoff.ts:234, seed/history.ts, paymentActions.ts:101, payablesActions.ts) contradicts the catalogue, where the payable matches the receivable and AA's fee is a separate invoice (domain-model, US-10.2.1, US-10.3.1, OQ-02). It drives the Contradicts on US-09.1.1 and US-09.2.1 and touches US-09.2.4. Fix it once, under EP-10, needing a PERSIST_VERSION bump and edits to the Xero sim, Accounts, payables run, GST and demo script (S1 Beat 2 lines ~245-270, S3 half-payment beat ~340-346).

Other themes: (1) The only substantial new EP-09 build is resilience: an outage/queue/backoff simulation and a 'Void in Xero' drift case; propose 'Simulate Xero outage' and 'Void this invoice in Xero' buttons. (2) Small S items: InvoiceNumber/Reference fields and labels on the Xero shapes and ACCREC card, Xero IDs on the admin invoice rail (US-09.1.1), buyer-created tax invoice wording (US-09.1.4, pending OQ-29), optional 'dedicated org' subtitle copy. (3) US-09.2.4 needs a Xero-side 'bill paid' event learned by webhook or poll (poll currently handles PaymentIn only). (4) The catalogue moves to an internal ledger as system of record (US-08.3.1/08.3.2); the prototype has no ledger, so 'ledger record' items map to BillingCase until EP-08 lands; EP-09 should then mirror ledger pairs. (5) The shell has no screen-contextual demo controls; new triggers can sit on the Xero sim pair detail and /demo/control, or the product owner's requested contextual slot must be built once in the shell. (6) Open questions: OQ-29 (blocks US-09.1.4 wording), OQ-30 (NHI; sim callout consistent), OQ-10 (unarchive), OQ-11 (duplicate-number setting). (7) Dependencies: EP-08 (US-08.3.1 ledger pair, US-08.4.3 numbers, US-08.4.5 agent presentation), EP-10, EP-15 (US-15.0.6 NHI privacy, already honoured by tests xeroNhi.test.ts).

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: Core defect: AA fee is a 5% deduction on the ACCPAY (agencyFee.ts, xeroHandoff.ts:234, types serviceFee* fields, selectors paymentHistoryFor, Web Payments AA fee / Net to you columns, DemoXero fee box, seed history.ts and billing.ts, tests). Catalogue (EP-10, FT-10.3, US-10.2.1, US-10.3.1 all Confirmed) says fee is a separate AA-to-anaesthetist invoice and the payable equals the amount received. Plan as TWO work packages, no double counting: (1) Remove fee from ACCPAY (closes US-10.2.1; EP-10 and FT-10.3 partly; bump PERSIST_VERSION; reseed; reword DemoXero cards; update S3 Beat 2/3 and S4 Beat 5 in demo-guide 03-demo-script.md, 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md lines 116-123, 02-workflows-and-handoffs.md lines 384-389, and master-demo-guide.html). (2) Add AA fee invoice entity + generation button + anaesthetist web view (closes US-10.3.1, FT-10.3, US-10.3.2). EP-10 is a roll-up of both. FT-10.2 regraded Matches (own text met; amount defect lives in US-10.2.1). US-10.2.4 needs a small Xero-simulator bulk remittance button and unmatched list (M). Already sound: single payment path, two independent money states, receipt reconciliation via shared receivePayment plus daily poll. Dependencies: EP-08 (ledger pair as first-class entity, system of record) since pair states live on BillingCase today; EP-09 (Xero mirror/ACCPAY authorise). Open questions needing labelled assumptions: OQ-02 (fee basis/frequency; also asks if fee nets against payables, so the 'separate invoice' reading is in the Confirmed text but not fully closed), OQ-47 (payment day/weekly cycle; no build needed now), OQ-19 (hospital dispute fallback; no behaviour). Existing demo controls cover payments: Control panel 'Payment received (webhook)' Full/Half, 'Run payables', 'Run reconciliation poll', Xero 'Simulate payment and payout'. New buttons proposed: 'Generate AA fee invoices' (Admin Billing Monitor + control panel scheduled jobs) and 'Simulate bulk hospital remittance' (Xero simulator Invoices tab). Catalogue screenshots for US-10.3.1 and US-10.3.2 show the current deduction UI and will be stale after the fix.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations:
Structure: no anaesthetist-facing Profile screen exists on mobile (More tab is a static persona card + demo note) or web (nav avatar is a label). The catalogue images for EP-12 are almost all admin-side (Master data) for the profile and anaesthetist-side for reports. One new Profile surface (unit value, GST period, contact, bank, prepaid tick list, editable by the anaesthetist and by the office on their behalf) would close US-12.1.1/.2/.3/.4 together; plan as one phase sharing the Admin anaesthetist editor (MasterData/EditAnaesthetistSheet).

Dependencies: US-12.1.3 needs EP-06 (US-06.1.1 prepaid set, US-06.2.1 derived trigger, prepaid estimate rules) and RVG groups (US-05.1.3); the per-procedure 'Pre-payment' payment category chooser (ManualCardForm, EditProcedureSheet, EditBillingSetupSheet) becomes redundant/contradictory, and seeded prepay cards (SEED_PREPAID_CARD_ID, prepaymentUnpaidList) would need re-seeding via the anaesthetist's prepaid set. US-12.1.4 bank details feed the EP-10 payables run (disbursePayable, Xero sim 'Pay now'). PERSIST_VERSION (13) must bump on any seed/shape change. US-12.1.1 snapshot ties to US-04.3.5 / US-08.4.4 (lock terms at authorisation). US-12.2.1/.2/.3 depend on EP-08 ledger semantics (US-08.3.1 to 08.3.5): decide whether 'unpaid payable' means uncollected from payer (current) or not yet disbursed; the Payments tab's 'AA fee = gross minus authorised' deduction conflicts with EP-10/FT-10.3 (AA fee on its own invoice), a cross-epic issue on the same Accounts screen.

Verification corrections: FT-12.2 regraded from Grouping to Matches (states its own ledger-not-Xero rule, which is honoured). Reviewer's 'Productivity/Leave unrequired' dropped (catalogue image includes productivity). Export/print and HPI-editability gaps dropped as not required. GST period gaps are small: alignment/period navigation on web plus label drift ('biMonthly' raw in Master data table vs 'Bi-monthly' vs 'Two-monthly').

Demo beats (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md, not re-read): beats using Balances/Overdue/aging or the GST tab, and any prepayment beat relying on the per-procedure 'Pre-payment' category, change if prepayment becomes profile-derived; a unit-value edit beat re-prices authorised lists today and should be revisited if a snapshot is added. No new demo-trigger buttons needed for EP-12: everything is user-visible without a control.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations:
Verified all 21 items by re-opening catalogue files and code. Result: 20 verdicts upheld, 1 corrected (FT-13.5 size L to M only). Tally: Matches 5 (US-13.1.2, 13.3.1, 13.3.2, 13.5.1, 13.5.2), Partial 6 (FT-13.5, US-13.1.1, 13.2.1, 13.2.2, 13.4.1, 13.6.2), Missing 4 (US-13.4.2, 13.4.3, 13.6.1, 13.6.3), Grouping 6 (EP-13, FT-13.1 to 13.4, FT-13.6), Contradicts 0. No false Matches found: the 5 Matches were re-checked against acceptance criteria, including the Confirmed-status ones' neighbours; US-13.2.x (the only Confirmed gaps besides US-13.4.1) are real gaps. Close calls: US-13.2.2 (Partial vs Missing, kept Partial since the Prior balance tag exists) and US-13.4.1 (Contracts editor uses the old Type 1/2/3 model, which is EP-04's Contradicts, not double counted here).

Key dependencies for the plan. (1) FT-13.6 is a foundation: build SurgeonRoom, extended Surgeon (registration, HPI/CPN), BlacklistEntry and Hospital.contactEmail (DM-26) once, then US-13.4.1 surgeon/room/hospital CRUD, US-13.6.1/2/3 and the loader targets in US-13.4.3 all reuse it. Consumers elsewhere: US-01.3.5 assignment warning, US-01.4.5 hand-over warning (swap flow not built), US-02.3.3 mailto To address, US-11.1.5 missing NHI, US-06.2.5 durations. list.conflict amber pattern can host the soft blacklist warning. (2) US-13.1.1 Draft Lists need the EP-01 Slot/List/Draft List split (DM-02/03); the booking-count part is S and independent. (3) US-13.2.1/13.2.2 ledger and patient balance: interim option is derived selectors over BillingCase + Xero mirror; the full internal ledger is DM-18/19 (EP-08); patient record shared with EP-11 US-11.3.1, build once. (4) US-13.4.2 and 13.4.3 should be one loader feature (approved-only, row validation, names-only Solutions Plus list), first slice on hospitals, surgeons and rooms, modifiers; procedure master and fee lines wait on EP-04/05. (5) Shell: there is no screen-scoped demo action mechanism (harness bar is global; all triggers live on /demo/control). Every demo_trigger proposed here (Add Draft List, Inject unmatched receipt, Simulate sign-in attempts, Go-live load, Load sample spreadsheet) needs one small shared 'contextual demo actions' slot in src/shell, so build that once first (S to M) and it unblocks all EP-13 triggers. Any seed shape change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). Demo-guide impact: S1 to S5 beats on Day view, Review/Authorise, Billing monitor Resolve & retry and Audit stay intact; S2 phone advice (Sharma PM, Hale prefill at PhoneAdviceBooking.tsx:89) touches the surgeon picker if it becomes room-linked and blacklist-grouped, so check the prefill hook; a new Ledger balance nav item and sign-in splash need cheat-sheet mentions.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: EP-14 is mostly Future Work (FT-14.1, 14.2, 14.3, 14.5 are Future and out of this grading). The in-scope substance is US-14.4.1 and FT-14.4, both already demonstrated (catalogue screenshots were taken from the prototype). FT-14.6 is Partial only because the feeds for the five other Christchurch providers and the manual-first baseline are missing. Main structural issue is cross-epic: the prototype has NO matching screen, unmatched queue, sync button or last-synced time (EP-02: US-02.1.2/1.4/1.5). It auto-applies feed messages to Cards through integrationActions.processMessage, which contradicts US-02.1.5's 'nothing applied until an admin decides' and 'No silent apply' criterion. That gap is owned by EP-02, but fixing it reworks the integration path (processMessage would write to a matching queue instead of Cards) and the simulator and monitor; FT-14.6 auto-matching then becomes a demo toggle on top. Demo-trigger proposal for the EP-02 sync: a 'Sync now' button on the matching screen plus a control-panel 'Deliver hospital sheet' button shown only on that screen. Demo script impact: S1 (Booking to theatre) fires MSG-STG-1001 in /demo/integrations and Sarah Mitchell appears as a Card; with a matching queue S1 needs an admin match step. S2 phone-advice (DEM1239) and S5 NHI/ethnicity beats are unchanged. Dependencies: EP-11 (US-11.1.5 NHI required plus problem list, not implemented: NHI is optional on Add card), EP-12 (US-12.1.4 bank details absent from Anaesthetist type). Open questions: OQ-13 (hospital formats and cadence, Open), OQ-22 (Contract from hospital data, Answered).

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: Structure: no restructure needed. EP-15 is a cross-cutting epic; fixes are cross-cutting, not screen-specific. Verified grades: 2 Matches (US-15.0.1, 15.0.5), 4 Partial (15.0.2, 15.0.3, 15.0.4, 15.0.6), 1 Grouping (EP-15); no Contradicts and no Missing. Dependencies: US-15.0.2 overlaps US-03.1.4 (same missing web set-availability; fix once). US-15.0.3 is the umbrella for US-04.3.5 (contract snapshot at AUTHORISED) and US-13.4.1 (reference data): implement the snapshot once in domain/store (Procedure snapshot fields, fee display reading the snapshot on AUTHORISED, PERSIST_VERSION bump, test that a post-authorisation master edit leaves invoice and displayed totals unchanged), then close all three; note an existing test (billingRun.test.ts:454-466) encodes the unlocked behaviour and would need revising. US-15.0.6 overlaps US-14.5.1 (dead-letter handling) and US-09.3.1 (Xero contacts). US-15.0.4 ties to FT-01.1 (4-month horizon) and the 5 MB localStorage limit (persistStorage.ts): a full-scale loader must be in-memory only with persistence paused, so no PERSIST_VERSION bump if the default seed is unchanged. Open questions: none list EP-15 items in `affects`, but OQ-30 (NHI in Xero, Open, affects US-09.3.1/US-11.1.1) bears on US-15.0.6 and OQ-49 (booking without NHI) is adjacent. Demo-guide impact: S3 line on 'NHI never crosses into Xero' stays valid; the cheat sheet 'NHI in Xero' entry (04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md ~209-213) is consistent with OQ-30 Open. S4 dead-letter beat (Integrations monitor) would gain a 'View raw message' step if the restricted-payload control is added. Snapshot work adds a natural S5 beat (authorise, edit unit value, show invoice unchanged). Hosting/DR/pen-test/support items in the EP-15 technical discussion are OutOfScope for the app; suggest a presenter talk-track slide only. Suggested phase grouping: (a) NFR proof pack: full-scale data loader + NHI leak scan + synthetic badge + restricted raw-message view (US-15.0.4, 15.0.6); (b) billing snapshot at AUTHORISED (US-15.0.3 with US-04.3.5); (c) web availability parity (US-15.0.2 with US-03.1.4). Optional low-priority: an in-context help layer for US-15.0.1 if the owner wants the RFP proposal shown.

items.requirement_says: Prepayment invoices use the same internal ledger and Xero pairing as other invoices, each creating its own linked receivable and payable.
items.prototype_does: raisePreProcedureInvoice creates Invoice{kind:'prePayment'} + BillingCase, then handoffCasesForCard creates the ACCREC + ACCPAY pair (D-pre-invoice-pair). Visible in the Demo Xero simulator and payment webhook control.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Card banner 'Raise pre-procedure invoice', then Demo Xero simulator shows the pair
items.verify_note: Confirmed Confirmed-status item: handoff code pairs every invoiced case incl. pre-payment; nothing contradicts. Only reachable for the seeded Riley card in practice.
items.title: Prepayment invoicing and tracking

items.summary: Prepaid amount is deducted and a positive balance invoiced, but an overpaid prepayment fails the card's billing instead of being credited.
items.requirement_says: After the procedure, prepaid amount is deducted from the final fee; balance invoiced, or credited if prepaid exceeded need.
items.prototype_does: Billing run nets ex-GST prepaid via a visible deduction line; $0 net raises no invoice; negative net returns exception negativeTotal ('needs a manual credit') and the case fails.
missing_or_wrong: No credit path when prepaid > final
Balance invoice not linked to the prepayment invoice
items.demo_trigger: Control panel scenario (Admin Review only): 'Stage overpaid prepayment' seeds a prepay above the final fee, then Authorise shows the credit
items.verify_note: Nothing implemented is wrong (failure on negative is a missing path, not a contradiction). Added the overpay demo trigger.
items.title: Settlement after the procedure

items.summary: No trust account, refund or replacement-prepayment concept; cancelCard ignores prepayment money. Proposed, pending OQ-40.
items.requirement_says: Prepayment money returned (mainly on cancellation) goes via AA's trust account, always refunded in full; the next anaesthetist starts a fresh prepayment. Proposed process (OQ-40).
items.prototype_does: Nothing. cancelCard soft-cancels; a cancelled card stops requiring prepayment and the paid prepayment invoice stays untouched.
missing_or_wrong: Trust account entity/view
Refund records as credit against the prepayment invoice
Replacement prepayment on rebook
items.demo_trigger: Admin cancel of a paid-prepay booking offers 'Refund from trust account'; Demo Xero simulator gets a 'Pay out trust refund' button on the refund row
items.verify_note: Grep for trust/refund/credit note across src found only unrelated hits (letterSpacing, untrusted). Upheld.
items.title: Trust account and cancellation refunds

items.summary: No profile UI or data for ticking prepaid RVG codes or whole groups.
items.requirement_says: Anaesthetist marks RVG codes as prepaid on their own profile, singly or as a group.
items.prototype_does: Nothing.
missing_or_wrong: Tick list of codes and groups on mobile and web profile
Persisted per-anaesthetist prepaid set
items.verify_note: No profile screen in web or mobile; no field on Anaesthetist.
items.title: Tick codes or groups

items.summary: No admin view/edit of an anaesthetist's prepaid settings (and no such settings exist).
items.requirement_says: Admin can view and edit an anaesthetist's prepaid settings on their behalf.
items.prototype_does: Nothing.
missing_or_wrong: Admin anaesthetist editor section for prepaid settings, audited as office actor
evidence: searched: prepaid|prepay in aa-prototype/src/apps/admin -> only card banner, day-grid flag and review flag
items.verify_note: Admin hits for prepay are card/day-grid/review flags only. S assumes US-06.1.1 data and store action exist first.
items.title: Admin can maintain on behalf

items.summary: Flags prepayment across the whole card (right) but from the Procedure's payment category, not the anaesthetist's prepaid RVG set.
items.requirement_says: Booking flagged prepayment-required when any Procedure's RVG code is in the anaesthetist's prepaid set; never triggered by Contract.
items.prototype_does: cardRequiresPrepayment = any non-cancelled procedure on billableParty route with category selfFundedPrepayment. 'Pre-payment required' banner on the shared card (mobile/web/admin) and $ flag on the admin day grid.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: trigger is a hand-set payment category, not RVG code vs prepaid set
Payment category picker must stop being how prepayment is chosen
items.verify_note: Whole-card check and never-by-Contract both correct in prototype; only the trigger is wrong. Depends on FT-06.1 data.
items.title: Detect prepayment requirement

items.summary: Full-vs-deposit exists in data but nothing in the UI sets either; full has no contingency; nothing stored on the Booking. Verify status.
items.requirement_says: Admin or anaesthetist sets prepaid amount; default estimated full fee at own unit value plus two contingency units, or a deposit; stored on the Booking.
items.prototype_does: Procedure.prepaymentDetail {type full|split, depositAmount} is written only by the seed. Choosing category 'Pre-payment' in the UI leaves it unset; completion validation then says 'Choose full or split' with no control to answer it. Raise treats missing detail as 'full' and prices via feeFor on captured/selected units at own unit value.
missing_or_wrong: No UI to choose deposit vs estimated full or enter a deposit
No +2 contingency units (OQ-38)

Amount not stored on the Booking; full is recomputed at raise time and, before the procedure, lacks time units (under-estimate; or refused with a misleading 'no self funded pre-payment procedure' message when it computes to 0)
Anaesthetist cannot set it, only the office button raises
evidence: grep prepaymentDetail writers in src -> seed and reads only
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld. Corrected mechanics: raise does not require prepaymentDetail (missing detail falls into the full branch), so the validation failure is at completion, not raise. Added pre-procedure under-estimate point.
items.title: Set the prepaid amount

items.summary: Full prepayment is worded as an estimated fee and a higher final is billed as balance, but a lower final fails and there are no estimate letters. OQ-38 open.
items.requirement_says: 'Full' prepayment is an estimate; final may be higher or lower; the request is always worded as an estimate via letter templates.
items.prototype_does: Invoice line 'Pre-payment, estimated full fee'; document note 'full estimated fee, payable before the procedure'; final higher -> deduction line + balance invoice; final lower -> negativeTotal failure. Document notes still carry stale 'discovery point for AA' wording.
missing_or_wrong: Lower-than-estimate path errors instead of resolving (US-06.4.2)
Document says nothing that the final may be higher or lower; no letter wording (US-06.3.6)
Deposit-type invoice says 'agreed deposit', fine, but not modelled as estimate vs deposit beyond full/split
items.verify_note: Confirmed wording and lower-final failure in code. Added the 'higher or lower' note gap.
items.title: Prepayment is an estimate

items.summary: Only a stand-in: 'full' calls feeFor on the procedure's captured/selected units at the anaesthetist's unit value. No estimator, estimated duration, contingency setting. Proposed; OQ-38, OQ-50.
items.requirement_says: Engine auto-calculates estimate: (Procedure base units + tiered time units from estimated duration + 2 contingency modifier units, a setting) x anaesthetist's own unit value.
items.prototype_does: feeFor with resolveBtm from captured units; tiered time rule exists in timeUnits.ts; unit value is the anaesthetist's own (fee.ts:187).
missing_or_wrong: No estimator taking estimated duration
No contingency modifier units and no setting
AC 90 min + 10 base = 10+6+2 not producible
Contract base-unit override applied? contract is deliberately deleted from fee context on the pre-invoice, so contract base units are ignored
No local-table replacement flow
Time rule present but OQ-50 unresolved
items.verify_note: Confirmed no estimator; added that contract is stripped from the pre-invoice fee context (relevant to 'a Contract may override base units'). Partial (vs Missing) is generous; the pure fee maths is reusable.
items.title: Calculate the prepayment estimate

items.summary: No estimated-duration field or admin entry on a Booking.
items.requirement_says: Admin records the estimated duration from the surgeon's rooms on the Booking; the prepayment estimate uses it; final units come from actual times.
items.prototype_does: Nothing.
missing_or_wrong: Estimated duration field on Card/Procedure
Admin input on booking detail
Feeds estimator (US-06.2.4)
evidence: searched: estimatedDuration|estimated duration|durationMin in src -> none
items.verify_note: Re-grepped; no hit.
items.title: Estimated duration from the surgeon's rooms

items.summary: Office raises a pre-procedure invoice to the billable party, creating the case and the Xero pair. Manual button rather than automatic at setup, but the story's own screenshots show exactly this flow.
items.requirement_says: Engine raises a prepayment invoice to the billable party at booking setup, creating a linked receivable and payable and the Xero pair.
items.prototype_does: Card banner 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' -> Invoice{kind:'prePayment'} to typed billable party else patient, BillingCase 'invoiced', Xero pair via handoff; refused once the List is AUTHORISED/billed; idempotent.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' on the Admin card; Demo Xero shows the pair
items.verify_note: Considered downgrading to Partial for 'at booking setup' (manual, not automatic) and for the amount source. Kept Matches: the catalogue screenshots for this Confirmed story show the manual button and the existing control satisfies the demo-trigger rule. Amount and letter gaps sit under US-06.2.2/06.2.4/06.3.6.
items.title: Raise the prepayment invoice

items.summary: Outstanding flag on day grid, card and review exists, but no part-paid display and no date-approach alert.
items.requirement_says: Admin sees unpaid, part paid or paid per prepaid Booking; alerted as the procedure date nears if still outstanding; can follow up or anaesthetist cancels.
items.prototype_does: prepaymentStatusFor = none/required/outstanding/paid/overridden; $ flag on day grid, 'Pre-payment flagged' filter, review flag 'Pre-payment outstanding', card banner (also on mobile/web). Part payment still reads 'outstanding'; the case itself is partPaid in the Billing monitor but the prepayment banner shows no amount received.
missing_or_wrong: No part-paid status or amount received on the prepayment banner/flag
No alert that escalates as the date approaches (flag is static, not date-driven)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:287 (partPaid chip exists on billing monitor only)
items.demo_trigger: Demo control panel (Admin Day view only): 'Move to 2 days before procedure' using the demo clock, which lights an admin alert on unpaid prepayments; or 'Send prepayment reminder' on the Booking
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld. Dropped the reviewer's 'completion gate is prototype-only' point: catalogue images for this story caption 'gate cleared'. Noted partPaid does exist on the billing monitor, just not on the prepayment status.
items.title: Track prepayment status and alert when outstanding

items.summary: Status is derived from the payment-mirrored case, so it re-evaluates after each reconciled receipt and only clears when receipts cover the invoice.
items.requirement_says: After each prepayment receipt is reconciled, the engine re-checks whether the prepayment is still outstanding.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment (webhook/poll) mirrors received money and status partPaid/paid onto the BillingCase; paidPrePaymentCaseForCard needs received >= invoice total, so half payment stays 'outstanding' and full flips to 'paid' and clears the gate. The control-panel payment webhook offers 'Half (partial)' and 'Full payment' on open ACCRECs including prepayment ones.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: control panel 'Payment received (webhook)' with Half/Full, and Demo Xero 'Simulate payment and payout'
items.verify_note: Re-checked Confirmed item against both catalogue screenshots (half received still outstanding; paid clears gate): behaviour matches.
items.title: Re-check after each receipt

items.summary: The requirement flag is derived, so changing the payment category clears the banner at once (matches the story's screenshots), but the amount, an already-raised invoice and Contract change are not handled. Verify status.
items.requirement_says: When Procedures or Contract change before the procedure, engine re-checks prepayment requirement and amount, clearing a no-longer-needed one automatically.
items.prototype_does: cardRequiresPrepayment is recomputed on read, so editing category to Self-funded removes the banner and gate immediately. No stored amount to recompute; a raised invoice stays untouched and is still netted at the run if the payer is unchanged.
missing_or_wrong: No amount re-estimate on Procedure or duration change (no stored amount)
Raised-but-no-longer-needed invoice is not voided or flagged
Contract change is not a trigger (moot once the trigger is RVG-based)
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/invoiceBuild.ts:311-330 (fails only if payer changed, not category)
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld. Corrected reviewer's claim that a category change after invoicing fails the balance run: the exception only fires when the counterparty changes (route/payer), not on category alone. Size M is likely S once amount is stored on the Booking (then re-check is a small hook).
items.title: Re-check when the Booking changes

items.summary: No prepayment letter templates or letter output. Proposed.
items.requirement_says: Admin picks one of a few standard estimate-worded letter templates when raising a prepayment; admins maintain templates; letter filled from the Booking and sent with the invoice.
items.prototype_does: Nothing; the invoice document carries fixed explanatory text only.
missing_or_wrong: Template master with admin maintenance
Template picker in the raise-prepayment flow
Merge fields (patient, procedure, estimate, anaesthetist) and letter preview
evidence: searched: template|letter in src -> only CSS letterSpacing
items.verify_note: Grep for template/letter yields only styling.
items.title: Prepayment letter templates

items.summary: Run at AUTHORISED deducts the prepaid amount and invoices a positive balance (nets to $0 for full), but the balance is not explicitly traceable to the prepayment invoice.
items.requirement_says: On AUTHORISED, engine calculates final, deducts prepaid already invoiced, invoices positive balance; attached to the Procedure and traceable to the prepayment invoice (not an additional invoice).
items.prototype_does: runBillingForList threads prePaidByProcedure; per-procedure deduction line 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced'; $0 net raises no invoice; payer-change and funder-split guards. Deduction is attached to the Procedure via procedureId, and prepayment/balance share the Card.
missing_or_wrong: Deduction/balance carries no reference to the prepayment invoice number or id
Document note refers only generically to 'a deposit'/'pre-paid'
items.demo_trigger: Existing: authorising a List runs the billing (Admin Review > Authorise)
items.verify_note: Core behaviour is correct; only the traceability sentence is unmet. Could be argued Matches, kept Partial because it is an explicit note in the story.
items.title: Invoice the remaining balance

items.summary: Overpaid prepayment is detected but yields a billing failure ('needs a manual credit'), not a credit surfaced for refund. Open (OQ-03).
items.requirement_says: When prepaid exceeds final, engine creates a credit and surfaces it for refund handling; how the refund is actioned is open (OQ-03).
items.prototype_does: Negative net for a counterparty returns exception negativeTotal; the card's BillingCase fails and waits for manual fix/retry. No credit note entity.
missing_or_wrong: No credit record or credit-note kind on Invoice
Nothing surfaced for refund handling
Whole card's billing blocked by the exception
items.demo_trigger: Control panel scenario (Admin Review only): 'Stage overpaid prepayment' seeds a prepay above the final fee, then Authorise shows the credit
items.verify_note: Open item: detection exists, credit does not. Could be graded Missing for the credit itself; kept Partial for detection and message. Shares a credit-note model with US-06.5.2 and US-08.6.2.
items.title: Credit or refund when prepaid exceeds final

items.summary: No trust account entity or view. Proposed; OQ-40.
items.requirement_says: System supports a trust account for prepayment money: cancelled prepayments return to it and refunds are paid out of it from the system.
items.prototype_does: Nothing.
missing_or_wrong: Trust account balance and movements
Refund payouts recorded in system
Reconciliation of prepayments and refunds in one place
Timing of money in/out unresolved (OQ-40)
items.demo_trigger: Admin 'Trust account' panel with a 'Record refund payout' action (Admin Accounts area)
items.verify_note: Re-grepped; no hit.
items.title: Trust account

items.summary: Cancelling a paid prepaid Booking creates no refund or credit; cancel just makes the card stop requiring prepayment. Proposed; OQ-40, OQ-42.
items.requirement_says: Cancelling a Booking with paid prepayment refunds it in full via the trust account, recorded as a credit linked to the prepayment invoice, even if the anaesthetist was paid; office handles it.
items.prototype_does: cancelCard soft-cancels only; cardRequiresPrepayment returns false for cancelled cards; the paid prepayment invoice and its Xero pair are untouched.
missing_or_wrong: Refund on cancellation and credit linked to the original invoice
AC: full refund whichever anaesthetist held it; credit linked in ledger
Recovery of the anaesthetist's payment (OQ-42)
items.demo_trigger: Admin cancel dialog on a paid-prepay booking: 'Refund prepayment from trust account' button; results in a credit row on the ledger and in the Demo Xero simulator
items.verify_note: Read cancelCard; no money handling. Needs a paid-prepay seed card that can be cancelled.
items.title: Refund a prepayment on cancellation

items.summary: No replacement-anaesthetist prepayment path. Proposed; OQ-40.
items.requirement_says: On rebooking to another anaesthetist after a cancelled prepaid Booking, raise a new prepayment at that anaesthetist's own unit value; the original is not transferred.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. Reassign moves the List/card; any existing prepayment invoice stays against its original case.
missing_or_wrong: Auto or guided new prepayment on rebook at the replacement's unit value
Two estimates visible to the patient
Depends on estimator (US-06.2.4) and refund (US-06.5.2)
items.demo_trigger: After a refund, Admin 'Rebook with another anaesthetist' on the cancelled card raises a fresh prepayment at the new unit value
items.verify_note: Confirmed no prepayment logic in cancel/reassign paths. Added a concrete demo trigger.
items.title: Prepayment for a replacement anaesthetist

items.summary: Epic body restates the DRAFT/SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED flow with links to the child stories; every rule is carried and graded in FT-07.x / US-07.x.x.
items.requirement_says: A List moves DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED; submit removes anaesthetist edit access; authorise locks Bookings, Procedures and selected Contracts and hands the whole List to the Billing/Invoice Engine.
items.prototype_does: Three-state lifecycle in store (submitList, authoriseList) with guards; detail graded under the children. Contract-version lock gap sits in US-07.3.1 (owned by US-04.3.5).
items.verify_note: Re-read EP-07 body: three sentences, each a link-out paraphrase of US-07.1.1, 07.2.1, 07.3.1/3.2. No rule not already in a child. Grading it normally would only double-count the US-07.3.1 gap.
items.title: List approval workflow

items.summary: One-sentence intro pointing to US-03.6.1 and US-07.1.1; no rule of its own.
items.requirement_says: While DRAFT the anaesthetist completes Bookings then submits the List.
items.verify_note: Body is a single sentence linking US-03.6.1 (complete) and submit (US-07.1.1). No AC.
items.title: DRAFT

items.summary: Restates US-07.2.1 (anaesthetist read-only) and US-07.2.2/2.3 (office reviews and corrects); no rule of its own.
items.requirement_says: Once submitted, the office reviews and corrects; the anaesthetist can see but not edit.
items.prototype_does: See children.
items.verify_note: Two-sentence body, both covered verbatim by children. Its screenshot (admin-review-queue) is the existing Review queue.
items.title: SUBMITTED

items.summary: Restates US-07.3.1/07.3.2 plus a one-line rationale (stable record for the engine); no separate rule.
items.requirement_says: Authorised List is locked and handed to the Billing/Invoice Engine as a single unit so the engine works from a stable record.
items.prototype_does: See children.
items.verify_note: Body = lock + hand-off (US-07.3.1/08.1.1) and rationale for immutability (US-07.3.2). Nothing extra to test.
items.title: AUTHORISED

items.summary: Billed List vanishes from every anaesthetist list view (keyed on billedAtISO) and its invoices appear in Balances from the next day.
items.requirement_says: Once a List's invoices are generated it drops off the anaesthetist's to-do view and reappears as lines in their outstanding balances.
items.prototype_does: isListBilled (billedAtISO stamped at billing-run completion) filters mobile Forward Lists, web Lists table, WeekStrip and web dashboard today-count. Balances (mobile and web) list flat ACCPAY invoices, visible from the day after raising; empty state says 'Balances appear the day after billing'.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Admin Review 'Authorise for billing', then demo clock 'Next morning', open Balances.
items.verify_note: Re-checked all four filter sites and the next-day rule in accpayInvoicesFor. 'Lines' = one row per invoice, consistent with US-12.2.1 flat list. Depends on OQ-31 via US-07.4.1, hence medium.
items.title: List visibility in the anaesthetist app

items.summary: Submit blocked while any non-cancelled Card is incomplete, blocker sheet lists what is missing per Card, submit sets SUBMITTED; mobile and web.
items.requirement_says: A List can be submitted as Completed only when every Booking is complete; otherwise submission is blocked and what is still missing is shown.
items.prototype_does: submitList guard cardsNotCompleted (cancelled Cards exempt). Mobile footer: grey 'Mark list completed · N to finish / Tap to see what is left' opens SubmitListSheet blockers listing each incomplete Card with its validation messages; teal 'Mark list completed' then confirm 'Submit to office'; success overlay. Web header: 'N to finish before submitting' / 'Mark list completed' using the same shared sheet. State becomes SUBMITTED, audited; footer becomes 'Submitted to office'.
missing_or_wrong: Cosmetic only: UI copy says 'Cards' not 'Bookings' (cross-epic terminology rename)
items.verify_note: Re-read store guard, sheet and both footers against the single AC and all 10 catalogue screenshot captions (ready/confirm/submitted/blocked/what-is-missing on both apps). Mobile blocked button is greyed-but-tappable, which is how the 'what is missing' screenshot is reached; not a defect. Terminology drift not an AC failure.
items.title: Submit a List

items.summary: Store guard and card UI make a submitted List read-only for the anaesthetist and mobile marks it 'Done · unbilled', but the web Lists table and WeekStrip carry no submitted/unbilled marker and the default range hides past submitted Lists.
items.requirement_says: Once SUBMITTED the anaesthetist cannot edit Bookings; the List stays visible, marked 'completed, unbilled', while the office reviews it.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal returns listSubmitted for anaesthetist edits; CardDetailBody canEdit=false hides edit/capture controls on both apps. Mobile Forward Lists 'Done' filter (no date limit) shows SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED-unbilled Lists with 'Done · unbilled'. Web List detail shows a 'Submitted to office' pill. Demo Data guard console can attempt editCard as Dr Souter on a submitted List and shows the refusal.
missing_or_wrong: Web Lists table (ListsScreen) rows show only the session StatusChip; no 'completed, unbilled' or submitted marker
Web Lists default From = today, so a submitted List from a past day (e.g. Monday when demo today is Tue 21 Jul) is hidden until the user moves From
Web WeekStrip and dashboard have no submitted/unbilled marking; web wording is 'Submitted to office', never 'unbilled'
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo Data guard console (editCard as Dr Souter on a submitted List) shows the refusal.
items.verify_note: Confirmed each web gap in ListsScreen/WeekStrip/DashboardScreen (grep for state/SUBMITTED/unbilled finds nothing on web outside detail pill). Dropped 'seed' from surfaces: default range problem is fixed in ListsScreen (include unbilled past Lists), not seed. Borderline Partial vs Matches since catalogue web screenshots only show read-only detail, but the text 'marked completed, unbilled' has no web equivalent.
items.title: Anaesthetist loses edit access

items.summary: Review screen shows route, first-procedure Contract, code, times, B/T/M, units, fee and a few flags, and the office can correct billing setup via card detail, but there is no explicit Contract approval, no insurer/address/invoice-email review, no under-18 billable-party check, and no drill-down from Review to a Card.
items.requirement_says: Admin reviews each Booking on a submitted List (Procedures, selected Contract per Procedure, insurance needed and insurer details, references, addresses and invoice emails, anything incomplete), approves or corrects Contract selections, and checks no patient under 18 is the billable party (block vs warn is OQ-54, Open; recommendation: flag at setup and review, block authorise).
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen table columns: Time, Patient, Route, Contract (first procedure only), Code, Times, B/T/M, Units, Fee, Flags + per-Card History. reviewFlags: not completed, pre-payment outstanding/overridden, missing billing reference, ACC billed to patient, manual B/T/M override. Office can correct via Day view > Card detail > OfficeBillingSetup (route, insurer on insurer route, payer, contract, reference, price override, funder allocation) on SUBMITTED Lists. 'Authorise for billing' is never gated by flags. Approval of Contracts is implicit in authorising.
missing_or_wrong: No under-18 / child-as-billable-party flag anywhere (Patient.dobISO and ageYears exist but are only displayed on card detail); no warn or block on authorise or at setup (OQ-54, shares work with US-11.2.4)
No explicit approve/confirm of the Contract selected for each Procedure; Review shows only the first Procedure's Contract (procCount > 1 shows '+N more' on patient line only)

Review does not surface 'insurance needs adding' or insurer details, addresses or invoice email addresses (BillableParty/Insurer email and address fields exist in types but are not shown in review or OfficeBillingSetup); Route column only
Review rows have no link to the Card or its billing setup, so 'approve or correct' is reachable only by leaving Review for Day view
Flags do not cover a missing/None Contract or an unset insurer on the insurer route as review flags (only shown as 'None'/'Not set' text in card detail)
evidence: searched: under 18|under-18|minor|isChild|age < 18|childBill in src -> none (only a comment at domain/types.ts:123 and ageYears display at shared/card/CardDetailBody.tsx:580)
items.demo_trigger: Propose: a Demo Data scenario 'Child billed directly' (or seed on a spare SUBMITTED List, not the S2/S3 Lists) staging a Card with a patient under 18 as billable party, so Review shows the flag and authorise warns or blocks per OQ-54.
items.verify_note: Re-read ReviewScreen and reviewFlags in full and OfficeBillingSetup: all reviewer gaps real; nothing implemented is wrong, so Partial not Contradicts. Added: fields for email/address exist but are not shown; no missing-Contract flag. Existing catalogue screenshots (review table, setup sheets) do exist in prototype, so the core is present. Added a concrete demo_trigger (needs seeded child case).
items.title: Office review of Contracts and references

items.summary: Office edits and price-overrides a submitted Booking directly, logs phone notes, and no 'returned' state exists anywhere.
items.requirement_says: Admin corrects a Booking directly without sending it back; no 'returned' state; issues resolved by an office-initiated phone call.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal lets the office edit DRAFT and SUBMITTED Lists; OfficeBillingSetup offers typed price override (dollar adjustment / fixed fee / percent, with reason) plus route/contract/reference edits and funder allocation on submitted Cards; 'Log phone note' on ReviewScreen (office only, any List state, audited, attaches to List) with copy that it never returns the List; no reject/return action exists in store or UI.
missing_or_wrong: Presentation only: Review screen has no direct link to the Card to apply the correction (reach via Day view); tracked under US-07.2.2
items.verify_note: Searched for any return/reject state: none (ListState is DRAFT/SUBMITTED/AUTHORISED; logListNote comment states no Returned state). Screenshots price-override, correction-saved and phone-note all correspond to existing UI. Missing Review-to-Card link is navigation, not an AC of this story.
items.title: Office corrections

items.summary: Authorise (confirm, office-only, lock, whole-List billing run, banner with invoice count) works, but Contracts are not version-snapshotted onto Procedures at lock.
items.requirement_says: Admin marks a submitted List AUTHORISED; this locks Bookings, Procedures and the Contract versions selected, and passes the whole List to the Billing/Invoice Engine as one unit; reference data (contract terms, rates, RVG values, unit value, party details) is snapshotted at lock.
items.prototype_does: authoriseList (SUBMITTED only, office only, audited) emits listAuthorised; runBillingForList processes the whole List atomically with per-card isolation and stamps billedAtISO. Confirm overlay, then 'List authorised · locked for billing' banner with invoice count; rows lock. Procedure holds only governingContractId (live reference, no version); invoice lines snapshot rate detail into descriptions at run time, and the run is synchronous so effective freeze is at authorise.

items.summary: Core Xero mirror (ACCREC + draft ACCPAY pair, webhook + daily poll, hidden-ID contacts, archiving) is built; the epic's resilience and divergence discussion (async queue, auto-retry with backoff, alerting, Xero-side void/amend drift) is not represented.
items.requirement_says: Dedicated Xero org under the engine (not system of record) mirrors an ACCREC and draft ACCPAY per ledger pair, detects payment by webhook plus daily poll, uses hidden-ID contacts. Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.
items.prototype_does: Handoff is synchronous inside one mutate after the billing run. A single armed fault (settings.failNextHandoff) records handoffFailure on the case, shown in Billing Monitor with a manual 'Resolve & retry'. Webhook and poll are simulated. No queue, no automatic retry/backoff, no outage or alerting, no drift detection. XeroAccRec 'voided' is typed and rendered but nothing ever sets it. Idempotency is present (accRecId no-op, per-payment key).
missing_or_wrong: No Xero outage / slow-API simulation showing the user flow unblocked while events queue
No automatic retry with exponential backoff, retry count or next-attempt visibility (manual Resolve & retry only)
No alerting of persistent handoff failure beyond the Billing Monitor chip
No divergence handling: an invoice voided/amended directly in Xero is never detected; no payment-against-credited-invoice ordering case
'voided' ACCREC status exists in types/UI but is never driven
Epic frames the engine ledger as system of record (US-08.3.2); prototype has no internal ledger, BillingCase + XeroAccRec/AccPay hold the money (dependency on EP-08)
evidence: searched: backoff|outage|queue|nextAttempt in src/store and src/apps/demo -> only integration (HL7) retry, none for Xero
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Simulate Xero outage' on the Xero sim (/demo/xero) and on /demo/control: while on, new handoffs and payment syncs go into a visible pending queue showing attempt count and backoff timer, while the user flow (authorise a List) continues unblocked. 'Restore Xero' drains the queue and pairs appear with no duplicates. Plus 'Void this invoice in Xero' on the pair detail so the next poll flags the mismatch for office resolution. Shell has no screen-contextual slot for these today, so they live on the Xero sim pair detail / control panel.
items.verify_note: Re-searched store and demo for queue/backoff/retry/void handling: only manual handoff retry exists; 'voided' has a label render but no writer. Verdict upheld. Added the system-of-record/ledger dependency point.

items.summary: One payment path modelled and shown in the Xero simulator; nothing routes money elsewhere.

items.title: All payments into AA

items.summary: Paid-in and disbursed are separate dated states on admin invoice, billing monitor and web Payments.
items.requirement_says: Track 'paid into AA' and 'disbursed to anaesthetist' as two separate states on every ledger pair (receivable and matching payable).

items.title: Two payment states

items.summary: Payment authorises the payable, but cumulative pro-rata of a 5%-reduced net rather than exactly the amount received; payment cycle (OQ-47) not modelled.
items.requirement_says: When a receivable is paid the matching payable is authorised. Full payment releases the whole payable; part payment releases a payable for exactly the amount received, remainder stays outstanding on the receivable. Payment day/cycle unsettled (OQ-47).
items.prototype_does: receivePayment clamps to balance, updates ACCREC, sets ACCPAY amountAuthorised = ratio x amountPayable (gross less 5%), mirrors to BillingCase; second payment authorises the rest; runPayables pays only the increment; remainder stays on ACCREC. Payables run is an on-demand office button.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: authorised amount = received x 0.95 (fee deducted), not exactly the amount received; amountPayable set from aaServiceFeeFor at handoff
Selectors derive serviceFeeAmount = received - authorised and Web Payments shows AA fee / Net to you columns from it
Weekly/Tuesday-Wednesday cycle not modelled (only if OQ-47 resolves that way; open, so no build required)
Seed history and billing seeds embed fee-reduced payables (history.ts, billing.ts) and need reseed + PERSIST_VERSION bump
Demo guide S3 Beat 2/3 ($7.62 fee, $144.76 net), S4 Beat 5 ('proportional payable share'), cheat sheet lines 116-123 and workflows doc lines 384-389 need rewording
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Payment received (webhook)' Full/Half then 'Run payables'; Xero 'Simulate payment and payout'. Only if OQ-47 adopts a weekly cycle: add 'Close accounting week' on the Billing Monitor payables panel.
items.verify_note: Verified in code and demo guide grep. Once fee is removed from ACCPAY, ratio x amountPayable equals received, so proRataAuthorised can stay. Added seed/doc points. Fee removal is prerequisite to FT-10.3/US-10.3.1 and shares work with EP-10.
items.title: Payable released to match the amount received

items.summary: Every receipt (webhook or poll) is reconciled to its billing case/invoice and displayed against the invoice; poll catches missed webhooks.

Web Payments shows receipt against invoice number; Xero pair shows engine link.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Run reconciliation poll' and day advance catch the seeded missed-webhook payment.
items.verify_note: Confirmed Status: Confirmed item; re-read poll and receivePayment. 'Ledger as system of record' (US-08.3.2) is an EP-08 gap; here the BillingCase mirror stands in. Confidence stays medium for that reason.

A hospital payer is possible only via the Contract-holder route and only the List's own hospital, and then pricing follows that hospital's contract.

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype was built against the July 2026 RFP. The catalogue has since moved on in ways that change the core model, not only the screens. Roughly a third of the in-scope stories match, about half are partial or missing, and around 30 items contradict the catalogue outright. The contradictions cluster on four foundations: the Slot/List/Draft List split, the Contract-as-whole-pricing-decision model, the money side (AA fee, ledger, credit/rebill), and the auto-applying hospital feed. Most of EP-05, EP-09, EP-12, EP-13 and EP-14 is sound or small. EP-01, EP-02, EP-04, EP-06 and EP-08 carry most of the work.

Sizing: Contract model (DM-06, DM-09, EP-04) is XL, intake/matching (DM-28, EP-02) is XL, Slot/List split (DM-02) is XL, Booking rename plus booking-level fields (DM-01) is L, and the ledger promotion (DM-18) is L. Parent epic and feature sizes are roll-ups of their children; do not add them.

### Themes

1. **Contract becomes the whole pricing decision (XL).** Route and Type 1/2/3 are replaced by one required, filtered Contract per Procedure with a default hospital Contract, categories, scope filters, required inputs, invoice presentation and version history. Items: EP-04, FT-04.3, US-04.1.1, US-04.2.1, 04.2.2, 04.2.5, 04.2.7, 04.2.8, 04.3.1 to 04.3.3, 04.3.7, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-07.2.2; DM-06, DM-08, DM-09, DM-14, DM-31; RV-08. This is the largest ripple: validator, invoice build, billing setup UI, review flags, seed and the S3/S4/S5 beats.
2. **Contract locked at AUTHORISED (L).** Contract versions and a per-Procedure snapshot so invoices regenerate exactly and the billing run stops re-resolving. Items: US-04.1.3, 04.3.5, 07.3.1, 08.1.1, 08.4.4, 15.0.3, 12.1.1; DM-07; RV-01. Plan once; five epics point at the same work.
3. **Hospital intake becomes admin-decided matching (XL).** Staged inbound rows, a matching screen, unmatched queue, field diffs, Draft List creation, sync state, and no silent apply. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, US-02.1.1 to 02.1.5, 02.5.1, 02.5.2, FT-14.6; DM-28; RV-13. The HL7/FHIR simulator and monitor are Future scope and stay demo-only (RV-05, RV-06).
4. **Slot, List and Draft List (XL structural, then M screens).** Items: EP-01, FT-01.2, FT-01.3, FT-01.6, US-01.2.3, 01.3.1, 01.3.3, 01.6.1 to 01.6.3, 13.1.1; DM-02, DM-03, DM-04; RV-14. Includes the swap-request flow (US-01.4.3, DM-05, RV-15) and the availability model (US-01.2.1, 01.5.3, 01.5.4). Vocabulary is unsettled (OQ-17, OQ-27, OQ-44).
5. **Booking rename and booking-level billing fields (L).** Card becomes Booking; billable party, invoice email, insurer/funding source, source and attachments move onto it. Items: EP-02, EP-03, US-11.2.2 to 11.2.4, 08.2.1, 08.4.2, 03.1.3; DM-01, DM-10, DM-34, DM-35; RV-12. Do the mechanical rename as its own first step.
6. **Multi-procedure rule and adjustment split (M to L, pure domain).** Exactly-one primary, modifier split above four units (3/2/2), Contract multiProcedureRule, Contract-gated anaesthetist adjustment separate from the office override, and Copy redefined as skeleton-only. Items: FT-03.2, FT-03.5, US-03.2.1, 03.2.2, 03.5.1, US-04.2.5, FT-05.3, US-05.3.1, 05.3.4, FT-05.4, US-05.4.1; DM-12, DM-13; RV-02, RV-03, RV-11. Cost FT-05.3/US-05.3.1/US-04.2.5 once.
7. **Prepayment is derived from the anaesthetist's prepaid set (XL epic, several M).** Profile tick list, RVG groups, estimator with contingency, estimated duration, letters, credit on overpayment, trust account and refunds. Items: EP-06, FT-06.1 to 06.5, US-06.1.1, 06.2.1 to 06.2.5, 06.3.2, 06.4.2, 06.5.1 to 06.5.3, US-12.1.3, US-05.1.3; DM-15, DM-16, DM-17; RV-09. Trust-account items are Proposed; schedule last.
8. **Money side: AA fee, ledger, credit and rebill (L each).** The 5% fee comes off the payable and becomes a separate AA-to-anaesthetist invoice (one root cause in EP-09/EP-10).
